name: Labeling (Drag Labels onto Image)

tier.label: Apply — Using Information in New Contexts

summary: Drag text labels from a bank onto correct positions on a reference image. Validates label placement with snap-to-anchor feedback.

aiGenerability.notes: AI generates label text and defines anchor points on images. Requires pre-prepared reference images with marked anchor coordinates. AI can generate distractor labels to increase difficulty.

prompt.description: Question or instruction asking learner to label the image. Example: 'Label the parts of a flower.'

imageUrl.description: URL to the reference image that will be labeled.

imageAlt.description: Descriptive alt text for the image (accessibility).

labels.description: Correct labels with their target anchor positions on the image.

text.description: Label text to display on a draggable tile.

position.description: Target anchor position (x, y) in image pixel coordinates.

snapRadius.description: Radius (pixels) within which label must land to snap. Default: 30px.

distractorLabels.description: Optional extra labels that don't belong (e.g., parts from a different organism). Increases difficulty by requiring selection.

explanation.description: General explanation of the labeled structure or system.

perLabelExplanations.description: Optional explanations for each label (keyed by label text). Shown on correct placement.

ux.mobileNotes: Labels appear in a scrollable bank below or beside the image. Drag label tile onto image. Snap-to-anchor animation when within radius. Snap feedback (highlight, gentle bounce). Correctly placed labels become immovable; incorrectly placed labels return to bank if released outside valid snap zone.

ageAdaptations.8-10: Max 4 labels. Large anchor zones (snap radius: 40–50px). Simple structures (body parts, plant anatomy, basic objects). Large touch targets (56×56px+). No distractors. Feedback shows gentle animation of correctly placed labels.
ageAdaptations.11-13: 6 labels. Moderate anchor zones (snap radius: 30px). More complex structures (organs, ecosystems, machinery). Standard touch targets. Optional 1–2 distractors. Feedback shows check mark and brief description.
ageAdaptations.14-16: Up to 10 labels. Tight anchor zones (snap radius: 20–25px). Complex diagrams (cell structures, chemical reaction, historical architecture, anatomical systems). Small touch targets acceptable. 2–5 distractors. Feedback includes scientific or historical context. Per-label explanations show on correct placement.
